idea-plugin.name: Core Commit AI
idea-plugin.description:
Generates TYPO3-style commit messages with a local Ollama model.
Sends a real unified diff of exactly the files checked in the commit dialog, formats [!!!][KEYWORD] Subject, 72-column * bullets and optional Resolves: / Releases: footer lines. Nothing leaves the machine except the request to your Ollama URL.

TYPO3 is a registered trademark of the TYPO3 Association. This plugin is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TYPO3 Association.

action.description: Generate a TYPO3 commit message from the selected changes with Ollama
